papers.title: LocoManiLab: A Unified Testbed for Data, Policies, Controllers, and Deployment in Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.classification_reason: 主要贡献是统一场景、示范、策略—控制器接口、数据生成及仿真 / 真机评测的试验台；Kimodo 适配是其中的数据生成研究，并非整篇提出新 VLA。
papers.library_summary: 234 项 G1 任务统一比较 12 种策略、5 种控制器与不同示范来源。XR-1 熟悉任务 80.2%，新任务 25.2%，新任务加新场景 8.2%；生成示范可成功回放仍不保证提高策略。
papers.platform: Unitree G1; MuJoCo; SONIC / AMO / HEFT / ALMI / ScaleBFM

code_status.value: Official project-site source still marks framework Code and Dataset Coming soon; public site and selected MP4 rollout repository available

method.contribution: unified testbed for data, policy-controller pairs, evaluation and deployment
method.runtime_input: head RGB, task text, model-supported robot proprioception
method.runtime_output: action chunk; each step is 64D SONIC token and 14 absolute finger targets

Kimodo_generation.input: text, executed motion prefix, root/wrist spatial targets
Kimodo_generation.output: 3-second, 30-Hz G1 motion reference tracked by frozen SONIC at 50 Hz
Kimodo_generation.navigation: A-star root waypoints from known occupancy
Kimodo_generation.manipulation: known geometry / task-annotated wrist stages and hand logic
Kimodo_generation.adaptation: Gaussian denoising transitions updated with group-normalized PPO-style policy gradient using execution rewards

main_protocol.aggregate: equal weight per task, not per rollout or split

real_world.training: separate policy per model and task; 50 real demonstrations for hardware, 50 sim demonstrations for simulation

papers.title: SP-HLM: Sparse-Pose-Driven Motion Generation and Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.classification_reason: 核心是五点显式约束与隐式运动先验结合的跟踪接口，以及 SP-GMT 和 SP-MGM；上层 SP-VLA 由 GR00T 适配，按主要贡献归运控侧。
papers.library_summary: VLA 输出骨盆、双腕、双踝和手指目标；蒸馏 Kimodo 补全全身运动，SP-GMT 联合显式目标与 VAE latent 跟踪。八项仿真成功率 52.75%，四项真机 65 / 55 / 25 / 40%，均有任务示范。
papers.platform: Unitree G1; ZED 2i; GR00T N1.7; Kimodo; SP-GMT

code_status.value: Official project-site source public; no explicit framework, checkpoint or full training-data download verified from site and organization repositories

method.pose_representation: 3D position and first two rotation-matrix columns as row-major 6D values
method.target_coordinates: world frame from VLA; transformed into current robot pelvis frame for tracker

SP_VLA.input: ego RGB, instruction, body joint positions, world pelvis pose and finger positions

motion_VAE.input: joint positions and velocities, 6D pelvis rotation, pelvis linear and angular velocities
motion_VAE.invariance: remove global horizontal placement and heading through yaw-aligned preprocessing

SP_GMT.input: motion latent, pelvis-frame sparse poses, proprioception and previous action
SP_GMT.training: asymmetric actor-critic PPO; reference motion supplies both target branches

stage_I.teacher_GT_weight_schedule: 0.9/0.1 to 0.3/0.7 over first 8000 updates, then fixed
stage_I.supervision: frozen-teacher clean prediction and paired ground-truth motion from forward-noised inputs

stage_II.supervision: frozen teacher corrects student-visited denoising states, plus temporal finite-difference losses

papers.title: Being-M0.5: A Real-Time Controllable Vision-Language-Motion Model
aliases: MotionCtrl: A Real-time Controllable Vision-Language-Motion Model
papers.classification_reason: 主要贡献为基于部位 residual quantization 的可控人体 motion 生成模型；HuMo100M 与多任务标注是数据贡献。没有机器人闭环任务评测，按大脑侧运动生成归档。
papers.library_summary: HuMo100M 视频伪标签与层级指令，配合五部位 PRQ 和 7B VLMM，实现部位、初始姿态与长动作生成。4-bit 达 20–28.9 motion FPS；HumanML3D 语义对齐更好但 FID 非最优，无机器人闭环验证。
